theme: Attenuation and negative feedback of RAS-ERK signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are the RAS-ERK cascade itself, from SHC/SOS activation and oncogenic RAS/MAP2K variants to its GAP, phosphatase and feedback brakes, framed here as the signal whose suppression and inactivation the theme is about.

theme: Restraint of myeloid inflammatory cytokine and chemokine production
core_role: The shared pathways describe monocyte/macrophage activation and proinflammatory cytokine and chemokine output, framed as the myeloid inflammatory response that is being negatively regulated.

theme: Dicarboxylate and organic anion transport across membranes
core_role: The shared pathways are the malate-aspartate shuttle and oxaloacetate metabolism, read as a dicarboxylate exchange system within broader membrane transport of TCA intermediates and organic anions.

theme: Integrin-Rap1 signalling in platelet activation and adhesion
core_role: The shared pathways are integrin adhesion signalling (Rap1, GRB2:SOS, p130Cas, talin/ILK cytoskeletal coupling) framed as the engine of platelet activation that drives cell spreading and degranulation.

theme: CSF1 and IL-6-family cytokine receptor signalling via STAT and ERK
core_role: The shared pathways are M-CSF/CSF1 and interleukin SHC signalling controlling macrophage proliferation, framed as one cytokine-receptor input converging with gp130 IL-6-family cytokines on JAK-STAT3 and ERK.

theme: Mitochondrial respiration control under hypoxic and oxidative stress
core_role: The shared pathways are cellular responses to hypoxia, oxidative stress and developmental apoptosis, framed as the stress and cell-fate outcomes of tuning mitochondrial respiration and ROS production.

theme: Magnesium, inositol and energy-phosphate transport and metabolism (loose)
core_role: The shared pathways are magnesium ion transport/homeostasis and inositol transport plus protein oligomerization terms, framed as multimeric membrane transporters supporting Mg-ATP-linked energy and nucleotide-precursor metabolism; the cluster is only loosely coherent.

theme: Selective autophagy pathways
core_role: The shared pathways are non-macroautophagic and selective degradation routes (chaperone-mediated autophagy, microautophagy, aggrephagy) plus ATG8 delipidation and nutrient sensing, framed as the core autophagy machinery alongside organelle-selective autophagy.

theme: Axon guidance and collateral sprouting
core_role: The shared pathways are Sema3A-driven chemorepulsion and positive/negative control of axon extension, framed as guidance cues that steer axon growth and branching.

theme: PAX3 transcriptional targets
core_role: The shared pathways are PAX3 motif and target gene sets defining a transcription-factor regulon, here linked to ALK-driven nuclear events and PTEN transcription.

theme: Mitochondrial heme and iron-sulfur cofactor biosynthesis
core_role: The shared pathways are heme and Fe-S cluster biosynthesis, framed as mitochondrial cofactor production coupled to the TCA cycle that supplies succinyl-CoA and uses Fe-S enzymes.

theme: ERK/MAPK activation and negative feedback
core_role: The shared pathways are ERK-cascade negative feedback, dephosphorylation and RSK activation, framed as the termination and downstream output arm of ERK1/ERK2 activation.

theme: Epithelial cell-cell junctions and adhesion
core_role: The shared pathways are cell-cell adhesion and apical junction components, including their apoptotic cleavage, framed as the epithelial adherens-junction system and its maintenance.

theme: Erythrocyte gas transport with heme and iron metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are red-cell membrane transport functions (O2/CO2 exchange, Rh-mediated ammonium transport), framed as mature erythrocyte function supported by heme synthesis, iron supply and erythroid differentiation.

theme: GABA and glutamate neurotransmitter uptake and metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are GABA synthesis, import and reuptake, framed as inhibitory transmitter cycling alongside excitatory amino acid transporters that supply and clear its precursor glutamate.

theme: Pre-mRNA splicing and 3'-end processing
core_role: The shared pathways are the spliceosome and snRNA cap hypermethylation, framed as snRNP-based splicing machinery within co-transcriptional mRNA maturation including polyadenylation and histone mRNA processing.

theme: Translation, ribosome quality control and RNA processing
core_role: The shared pathways are translation termination, stalled-ribosome rescue/RQC and NMD/no-go decay, framed as quality control of cytosolic translation within the broader cytosolic and mitochondrial translation and tRNA-processing machinery.

theme: mRNA deadenylation, decay and stabilization
core_role: The shared pathways are cytoplasmic mRNA turnover (deadenylation, decapping, 5'-3' decay and IGF2BP-mediated stabilization), framed as the post-nuclear fate of transcripts whose poly(A) tails are set by 3'-end processing.

theme: Leptin-ghrelin control of feeding and growth
core_role: The shared pathways are leptin signalling and regulation of body growth, framed as hormonal energy-balance control linking appetite and feeding behaviour to somatic growth.

theme: Phagocyte respiratory burst and antimicrobial killing
core_role: The shared pathways are NADPH oxidase respiratory burst, neutrophil degranulation and killing of bacteria and fungi, framed as the effector killing arm of myeloid inflammatory activation.

theme: Glycan biosynthesis and glycoconjugate metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are Golgi N-/O-glycosylation, glycosphingolipid and blood-group antigen synthesis and nucleotide-sugar transport (with CDG defects), framed as glycan building balanced by lysosomal glycan degradation and sugar-precursor metabolism.

theme: ER-Golgi vesicle trafficking via COPI and COPII
core_role: The shared pathways are COPI vesicle budding and Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic, framed as the return arm of the early secretory pathway complementing COPII-mediated ER export.

theme: Synaptic plasticity and dendritic spine remodelling
core_role: The shared pathways are structural synaptic plasticity, long-term plasticity and local translation at synapses, framed as the mechanisms of activity-dependent synapse strengthening and maturation.

theme: COPI vesicle trafficking between ER and Golgi
core_role: The shared pathways are COPI vesicle budding and retrograde Golgi-to-ER traffic, framed as vesicle formation that pairs with vesicle targeting in the early secretory pathway.

theme: Glutamatergic synaptic transmission via AMPA and kainate receptors
core_role: The shared pathways are AMPA receptor regulation, clustering and diffusion trapping, framed as postsynaptic excitatory transmission modulated by presynaptic kainate receptors and G-protein channel control.

theme: Monocyte and neutrophil inflammatory activation
core_role: The shared pathways are monocyte signatures, inflammatory response and myeloid immunity, framed as myeloid leukocyte activation including neutrophil degranulation and complement signalling.

theme: Glycan trimming and lysosomal glycoconjugate degradation
core_role: The shared pathways are glycosidase-mediated N-glycan processing and lysosomal oligosaccharide catabolism, framed as glycoside hydrolysis in line with lysosomal ganglioside and glycosphingolipid breakdown.

theme: Lipoprotein remodeling and cholesterol efflux
core_role: The shared pathways are HDL and LDL particle remodeling, framed as plasma reverse cholesterol transport fed by ABC-transporter-mediated lipid efflux and HDL assembly.

theme: Sulfur amino acid and selenium metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are transsulfuration and cysteine/sulfur amino acid catabolism, framed as the chalcogen amino-acid pathway that also processes selenium compounds.

theme: Peroxisomal lipid metabolism and cholesterol biosynthesis
core_role: The shared pathways are mevalonate/isoprenoid and sterol biosynthesis, framed as lipid synthesis alongside peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation, plasmalogen synthesis and peroxisome biogenesis.

theme: Actin filament turnover at the leading edge
core_role: The shared pathways are actin severing, depolymerization, capping and Arp2/3 control, framed as actin dynamics that drive lamellipodium and pseudopodium protrusion.

theme: Platelet activation and degranulation via integrin signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are platelet activation, degranulation, SNARE disinhibition and cytoskeletal remodeling, framed as the hemostatic platelet response driven by integrin-Rap1 adhesion signalling.

theme: Xenobiotic, alcohol and toxin detoxification
core_role: The shared pathways are phase I/II metabolism of xenobiotics, ethanol, mycotoxins and steroids, framed as detoxification that ends in aldehyde clearance.

theme: Mitotic spindle assembly, checkpoint and segregation
core_role: The shared pathways are spindle midzone assembly, spindle elongation and kinetochore attachment, framed as spindle mechanics of chromosome segregation under spindle-checkpoint and PLK1 control.

theme: Dendritic cell and monocyte surface antigen-presentation signatures
core_role: The shared pathways are surface marker signatures of dendritic cells and monocytes, framed as antigen-presenting cell identity and differentiation.

theme: Notch receptor activation and target transcription
core_role: The shared pathways are Notch-HLH target transcription, framed as the nuclear output that follows Notch receptor proteolytic activation.

theme: RNA Pol II promoter-proximal pausing and elongation
core_role: The shared pathways are early elongation complex formation, CTD phosphorylation and pausing (including the HIV Tat context), framed as the pause-release checkpoint in RNA Pol II transcription elongation.

theme: Post-transcriptional control by RNA-binding proteins and miRNAs
core_role: The shared pathways are IGF2BP-mediated mRNA stabilization, P-body assembly and translation promotion, framed as mRNA stability and translation control counterpart to small-RNA silencing.

theme: Amino acid catabolism (threonine)
core_role: The shared pathways are generic amino acid and amide catabolism, framed concretely as threonine degradation.

theme: Microglial response to amyloid and apoptotic cell clearance
core_role: The shared pathways are microglial activation, proliferation and cytotoxicity in response to amyloid-beta with neuronal and synaptic damage, framed alongside DAP12/TREM2-type efferocytosis of apoptotic cells.

theme: RUNX family transcriptional regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are RUNX1/2/3 regulation of genes for myeloid differentiation, BCR, interleukin and WNT signalling, framed as RUNX-driven haematopoietic transcription.

theme: Neutrophil recruitment, chemotaxis and extravasation
core_role: The shared pathways are diapedesis and neutrophil migration/extravasation, framed as the transendothelial step of neutrophil recruitment driven by formyl-peptide and chemotactic GPCR signalling.

theme: Dopamine and catecholamine synthesis and reuptake
core_role: The shared pathways are dopamine biosynthesis and catecholamine uptake, framed as monoaminergic neurotransmission and its synaptic regulation.

theme: Nuclear envelope breakdown and reassembly in mitosis
core_role: The shared pathways are nuclear envelope disassembly, ESCRT-III resealing and abscission, framed as mitotic nuclear envelope remodeling including nuclear pore disassembly and reformation.

theme: RAS-RAF-MAPK signalling downstream of FGFRs and oncogenic mutants
core_role: The shared pathways are RAF/ERK activation and its negative feedback, framed as the common intracellular cascade downstream of FGFR signalling and mutated RAS/RAF/BRAF.

theme: TLR and inflammasome regulation of inflammatory cytokines
core_role: The shared pathways are TLR3/4 signalling and IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production, framed as innate microbial-sensing cytokine output alongside inflammasome and IL-1 processing.

theme: Glandular and reproductive organ epithelial development
core_role: The shared pathways are mammary and prostate gland branching and epithelial differentiation, framed as glandular organogenesis within reproductive, pancreatic and endocrine organ development.

theme: Aquaglyceroporin glycerol transport and thermogenic fat metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are aquaporin-mediated glycerol and urea transport, framed as adipocyte glycerol release during lipolysis that feeds fatty acid cycling and thermogenesis.
